name: plugin.evaluator_critic
description: Adversarial code review, AST static analysis, destructive command safety filter, and plan feasibility critique

entrypoints.name: critic_evaluate_code
entrypoints.description: Statically analyze code syntax, complexity, function docstrings, and potential anti-patterns

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Programming language (python, javascript, json, default: python)

entrypoints.name: critic_review_plan
entrypoints.description: Evaluate an execution plan for logical consistency, risk factors, and missing dependencies

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: List of planned action steps as strings

entrypoints.name: critic_check_safety
entrypoints.description: Scan a CLI shell command for dangerous or irreversible operations

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Shell command to scan for safety violations
